s6aPwa: Install this portal using your browser’s Install app option. It uses the same verification and API. Offline shows only a notice; no data is saved or queued.
s6aNative: Dedicated Android/iOS apps and external institution integrations are not connected. Use this portal through your browser.
s6aEmailNote: Verification is required before storage. Receiving email creates a DRAFT only. Open it, preview the PREVENT advice, then confirm in the portal.
s6aCsvNote: Preview, dry-run, then explicitly commit. External references remain idempotent.
s6aQuarantine: PID/ICID conflicts stay quarantined for data-health review. Only valid rows are committed.
s6aAttachmentsDropped: Email attachments are dropped; no attachments are imported.
s6aReporterNote: Each row needs an existing verified RP reporter ID. The administrator is not substituted as the complainant.
s6aPreviewPending: Email preview and confirmation are pending S1b integration. No submission is available on this page.
